question: What is the name of the equestrian competition event that began on March 25, 2025, and ended on March 30, 2025, where Witharika Singhania secured the first position?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Azathof CSI Lier**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Azathof CSI Lier is an international equestrian competition held in Lier, Belgium, renowned for showcasing top-tier talent in showjumping events.
 
• The 2025 edition of the Azathof CSI Lier ran from March 25 to March 30, featuring competitive events across multiple categories.
 
• Witharika Singhania, representing India, secured the first position in one of the prestigious showjumping events during this competition.
 
• The Azathof CSI Lier is recognized for attracting elite riders and horses from across the globe, making it a significant event on the international equestrian calendar.
 
• The competition adheres to the regulations set by the International Federation for Equestrian Sports (FEI), ensuring high standards of integrity and professionalism.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Equestrian Sports:**

 
 
• Equestrian sports include disciplines like showjumping, dressage, and eventing, governed internationally by the FEI.
 
• Showjumping involves riders and their horses navigating a course of fences within a set time, testing speed, agility, and precision.
 
• Dressage focuses on the horse's ability to perform predefined movements, emphasizing harmony between rider and horse.
 
 
 
• **International Federation for Equestrian Sports (FEI):**
 
 
• The FEI is the global governing body for equestrian sports, founded in 1921 and headquartered in Lausanne, Switzerland.
 
• It oversees major competitions like the Olympics, World Equestrian Games, and other international events.
 
 
 
• **Witharika Singhania:**
 
 
• Witharika Singhania is an emerging talent in the equestrian world and a prominent Indian rider excelling in international competitions.
 
• Her success at the Azathof CSI Lier 2025 highlights India’s growing presence in equestrian sports on the global stage.
 
 
 
• **Belgium’s Role in Equestrian Sports:**
 
 
• Belgium is known for its rich equestrian tradition, hosting numerous international events and producing world-class riders and horses.
 
• Facilities like the Azathof equestrian center offer state-of-the-art amenities for training and competitions.
